scope: Incomplete development campaign. MEASURED/exit 0 means the experiment completed, not that replacement targets pass. Every loss remains open. Original 454 input targets and new fixtures are retained. No release or quiet speed claim.

warm.scope: Loaded-machine development diagnostic. Original 454 targets preserved and expanded. Same native/float output and ordered indices; decoding, output extraction and disposal in totalMs. Rust decodeMs includes private ABI serialization; prebuilt decodeMs ends at decoded geometry. Metadata text/lifecycle integration remain separate. First is first call in this process; true cold processes and RSS are measured separately. No quiet speed claim.
